title: Slingshot!
description: Changes Bow and Arrow to Slingshot and Pebble!
body:
<center>

Goofy little project I made because, why not?

Slingshot! **changes the textures** of the Bow and the Arrows (and their variants) to look like  
**Slingshots and Pebbles**.  
It **renames** them accordingly too, except for Tipped Arrows, I cant get those to work.

![Preview Image, containing Skeleton shooting a slingshot and the pebble and slingshot item in item frames.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a24838b96d9d9426433372654cefa28d1844a56c.png)

Compatible with minecraft versions 26.2 to 1.13!  
Older versions have been checked based off their assets file format.  
There shouldn't be any issues though.

</center>
